title: Alerts API: Unhandled JSON Parse Exceptions
description: POST and PATCH endpoints call await request.json() outside try-catch. Malformed JSON causes unhandled errors.
evidence: Line 59 POST, line 75 PATCH - request.json() calls outside try-catch block. Conductor route.ts line 88 shows correct pattern.
recommendation: Wrap request.json() calls in try-catch. Return 400 with validation error on parse failure.

title: Brain API: Missing Crypto Module Import
description: Uses crypto.randomUUID() without importing crypto module. Will fail at runtime with undefined reference.
evidence: Line 54 calls crypto.randomUUID() but imports (lines 1-3) do not include crypto module.
recommendation: Add 'import { randomUUID } from crypto'. Replace crypto.randomUUID() with randomUUID().

title: Zero Authentication and Authorization
description: All 8 API endpoints lack authentication/authorization checks. Any client can call modifying operations without credentials.
evidence: Search for auth patterns returns only dummy task. System marked PRODUCTION READY but has no security layer.
recommendation: Implement JWT/API key authentication. Add authorization middleware to verify user permissions before operations.

title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
description: All endpoints can be called unlimited times. No rate limiting, throttling, or request quotas implemented.
evidence: Search for 'rateLimit|RateLimit|middleware' returns zero results across all API endpoints.
recommendation: Implement rate limiting middleware. Use redis-based or in-memory rate limiter. Limit to 100 requests/minute per IP.

title: Race Conditions in File-Based Storage
description: Multiple API instances writing to same JSON files simultaneously will cause data corruption. No concurrency control.
evidence: All endpoints read, modify, then write JSON files directly. No locking mechanism. Example: loadTasks() -> push -> saveTasks() is not atomic.
recommendation: Migrate to database (Supabase) or implement file-based locks using lockfile package. Add atomic write operations.

title: Brain API: Silent Failure on Malformed Files
description: When reading company-brain JSON files, malformed files are silently skipped with empty catch block. No logging or alerting.
evidence: Line 49: catch (e) { // Skip malformed files } - silently ignores parsing errors without logging.
recommendation: Log parsing errors to ensure visibility. Consider moving malformed files to quarantine directory for investigation.

title: Insecure ID Generation with Timestamp Collisions
description: Multiple endpoints use Date.now() for ID generation. Can collide if called within same millisecond.
evidence: Alerts line 39: alert_${Date.now()}, Kanban line 68: Date.now().toString(), Meetings line 84: meeting_${Date.now()}
recommendation: Use crypto.randomUUID() or append random suffix: Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,9)

title: Data Files Not in .gitignore
description: dashboard/data/ directory containing alerts.json, conductor-logs.json, meetings-log.json, etc. are NOT in .gitignore. May be committed to repository.
evidence: .gitignore has 75 lines but does not exclude /data or *.json files. Files exist: alerts.json (194B), meetings-log.json (2870B).
recommendation: Add '/data/' and '/dashboard/data/' to .gitignore. Move sensitive data outside version control.

title: Brain API: Unbounded parseInt on Limit Parameter
description: parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20') does not validate result. NaN or invalid values passed silently.
evidence: Line 25: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(...), 100) - no isNaN check. Invalid query param returns NaN then Math.min returns 100.

title: Health API: Type Safety Issue with Any Type
description: getMeetingsLogStats() uses 'any' type in map callback. No type checking on log objects.
evidence: Line 51: logs.filter((l: any) => l.status === 'scheduled') - uses loose 'any' type instead of proper MeetingLog interface.
recommendation: Replace (l: any) with proper type: (l: MeetingLog) or unknown type guard with type assertion.

title: Profiles API: Silently Fails on Missing Environment Variables
description: Uses process.env.HOME or process.env.USERPROFILE without validation. Returns empty array silently on missing path.
evidence: Line 12: path.join(process.env.HOME || process.env.USERPROFILE || '', '.hermes', 'profiles') - if both env vars missing, path becomes wrong.
recommendation: Validate env vars at startup. Throw error with clear message if HOME/USERPROFILE undefined. Add fallback path.

title: Metrics API: Hardcoded Static Data
description: GET /api/metrics returns hardcoded static metrics instead of querying actual system data. Values never change.
evidence: Lines 27-48 define metrics object with fixed values: revenue: 1250000, expenses: 850000, etc. Not fetched from database or service.
recommendation: Replace with actual data fetch from Supabase or metrics service. Calculate real values from meetings-log.json or database.

title: Generic Error Handling Hides Root Causes
description: All error responses return generic 500 with message like 'Failed to load meetings'. Actual error details not included in response.
evidence: Example: meetings/route.ts line 148 returns generic 'Failed to load meetings' with no error details for debugging.
recommendation: In development: include error.message and stack. In production: log detailed error, return unique error ID to client for tracking.
